summary: Iteration 23 - Complete frontend testing of new registration flow steps for suppliers. Verified 'Oblast působení' (Service Areas) and 'Portfolio a reference' (Portfolio) steps appear correctly for supplier and customer_supplier roles, but NOT for customer role. All features working as expected.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Registration flow fully tested. Supplier role has 8 steps (with IČ) or 7 steps (without IČ). Customer role has 4 steps (without IČ) or 5 steps (with IČ). Customer_supplier role has 7 steps (without IČ) or 8 steps (with IČ). Service areas and portfolio steps are optional and can be skipped.
